applies_why: The judge disposes of C4 by noting that the challenged curse limb was dropped, so it does not perform a verse-by-verse stating-verse test.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the phrase 'when the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together': one reading applies K-C to any pressed link even if later dropped, and the other applies it only to a live link still under challenge; I weighed the latter because the judge's ground is the recorded dropping.
why: The judge's ground is the defender's recorded dropping of the curse limb, leaving no live link for K-C's chain-against-chain test.
